name: Io
about: Io as a small disc in front of or behind the backdrop planet (a mission's backdrop.moons).
mapWhy: USGS Astrogeology, Io Galileo SSI / Voyager colour merged global mosaic 1 km (public domain: access constraints 'public domain', use constraints 'none'), the 1024 x 512 browse image; docs/licences/planets.md
albedoScaleWhy: ours: the mosaic is a contrast-stretched picture (linear mean 0.26); Io's geometric albedo is about 0.6, so the scale brings the mean to 0.52 and the brightest frost to white

moon.why: Io's orbit radius and period (NASA planetary satellite fact sheet): 421,700 km, 1.769 days; its orbit lies in Jupiter's equator plane to within half a degree
